why: No major reviewer or authority shows up in these results. The sources are homestead blogs with unnamed one-off setups, niche pages that do the energy math but recommend against solar and name no product, a DIY sizing calculator, and lamp or waterer roundups that answer a different question. Three results have no readable text. None of them names a specific, priced generator matched to a waterer's wattage. A page that pairs low-watt waterers with named kits, shows runtime and current prices, and says honestly where solar falls short would stand out.
